title: junco.json
description: Project config written by `junco init` and updated by `junco add` / `junco update`.

registry.description: Registry base URL (https://junco.madebytobi.com/r) or a local folder of <name>.json files.

mode.description: package: @import "@junco/tailwind". inline: a generated junco.css copied into the project.

aliases.description: Import aliases written into copied files. null writes relative imports.

paths.description: Project-relative folders the aliases point at.

installed.description: What `junco add` wrote, so `junco diff` and `junco update` can tell your edits from upstream changes.

hash.description: Registry item hash at install or last update.

files.description: Project-relative path -> hash of the content Junco wrote.
